items.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998

ctx.x: They came up there and called and said could we come over for lunch. And Dick had to leave to go, he was working on another Woody Allen thing you know. So I didn’t get to see him that time, but we had lunch with Julia, wait a minute — I lost my—
Well we were talking about Lee Wiley and some of the singers.
